topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The rain had painted the city in shades of gray by the time I picked up the package. Addressed to me, or so they thought. The name scrawled on the label wasn't mine, not for a good ten years, not since I swapped my old life for this one. I ran my thumb over the worn edges, knowing this city and the ghosts it keeps. Opened it under the dim light of my desk lamp. Inside, a stack of old photos, a watch, a letter. The kind of things a man might leave behind, the kind of things a man might come back for. I've seen this game before. This time, I'd stack the deck in my favor.
